russia: of HALEU was Russia. Imports banned.
aria: The fuel chain from mine to microreactor in seven steps. One, mine: ore is about 0.7 per cent U-235, bought worldwide. Two, convert: uranium into UF6 gas, done at industrial scale. Three, enrich: centrifuges raise U-235 to 5 per cent for ordinary fuel or 19.75 per cent for HALEU; America has one HALEU line, 16 centrifuges run by Centrus in Ohio. Until 2024 Russia was the only commercial seller of HALEU, and imports are now banned. Four, deconvert: the gas is turned back into a solid; GAO says this does not yet exist for HALEU. Government stock of about 21 tonnes by 2028 enters here. Five, make TRISO: about 0.7 tonnes of uranium a year from BWXT and Standard Nuclear. Six, ship: one package is approved for HALEU gas and has not been manufactured; stricter security applies above 10 per cent. Seven, reactor: loaded once, runs three to eight years, 1 to 20 megawatts of electricity. Enrichment, deconversion and TRISO are marked as choke points.
